pattern: SELECT .* FROM (.*?) JOIN (.*?) ON (.*?) \( SELECT MIN\(.*\) FROM (.*?) JOIN (.*?) ON (.*?)\)
correction: Join tables first and then order by the specified column for minimum value

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries where a subquery is used inappropriately during the join process. The correct approach is to join tables first and then apply any necessary aggregation or filtering.
